decision: All six phases of the plan executed in order. Phase 1 produced a fresh, command-cited measurement record (reports/02_execution-time-measurements.md). Phases 2-5 rewrote specs/ROADMAP.md's Section A (sorry census + neutral footnote), the Completed section (decidability instances, CS5, Temporal tableau), Section B (terminal rows moved to Completed, BXCanonical decision tracked as task 607), and Section C plus four new Remaining stream sections (Modal Tableau Decidability, Constructive CS5, Temporal tableau, Propositional upstream), giving all 46 open tasks roadmap presence. Phase 6 audited every numeral back against the measurement record and found zero unexplained residue. Significant finding, escalated and RESOLVED: the plan's predicted sorry-census correction (27->45) was backwards -- the designated lean-sorry-census.sh script double-counts warn.sorry suppression annotations as phantom sorries (a genuine regex bug, `\bsorry\b` also matching inside 'warn.sorry'). The true raw count (27) matches the OLD roadmap figure. This was escalated to team-lead, who independently re-derived and CONFIRMED the finding (corrected-regex re-run reproducing 45->27 and 41->23 exactly) and WITHDREW the task's non-negotiable constraint. Per team-lead's explicit instructions: ROADMAP.md's census line stays at 27 with a neutral footnote (not a methodology narrative); follow-up task 608 was retargeted to the correct source-store path (agent-system/extensions/lean/scripts/lean-sorry-census.sh, not the deployed .claude/ copy); a correction addendum was appended to reports/01_roadmap-realignment-verification.md (committed by team-lead) marking its withdrawn finding. Task 607 (BXCanonical decision) was created per the plan's own requirement. No .lean file was touched by this task.
